1.explanation: These four files correspond to the four types of navigation elements in the Nav component: Item, PopupItem, SubNav, and Group. Each of these files contains logic for rendering their respective navigation elements, including how they handle the iconOnly prop. Currently, when iconOnly is true and no icon is provided, they render a placeholder span or an empty space. To fix the bug, the rendering logic in each of these files needs to be updated so that if iconOnly is true and no icon is provided, the item should not be rendered at all, rather than rendering a blank placeholder. This will prevent empty entries from appearing in the navigation bar in iconOnly mode.
1.bug_scenario: When the Nav component is set to iconOnly mode, any navigation item (Item, PopupItem, SubNav, Group) that does not have an icon configured still renders a blank space or placeholder, resulting in empty or misaligned entries in the navigation bar. The attached image shows a vertical navigation bar where some items are just empty spaces, which is confusing and visually unappealing. The expected behavior is that items without an icon should not render at all in iconOnly mode, rather than showing a blank placeholder.
